FIELDS.NAME: Ace Hardware & Home Improvement
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Ace Hardware & Home Improvement operates as a retail hardware and home improvement store, offering a wide range of products including tools, building materials, paint, garden supplies, and home improvement items. Our core operations focus on serving both DIY customers and professional contractors, providing quality products alongside exceptional customer service. We maintain a strong inventory management system to minimize shrinkage and ensure product availability. Safety is paramount; therefore, we have documented employee training and safety protocols in place to comply with OSHA regulations and enhance workplace safety. Our stores are equipped with secure storage for outdoor inventory to protect against weather damage and theft. We actively engage with our community through in-store workshops and demonstrations, helping customers make informed purchasing decisions while promoting proper safety practices. Furthermore, we comply with all necessary regulatory guidelines regarding the storage and sale of hazardous materials, maintaining a responsible approach to environmental stewardship.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in any activities that violate licensing requirements and confirms that all necessary business licenses and permits are in place. We uphold stringent standards by storing, labeling, and selling hazardous materials in full compliance with environmental and safety regulations, and there are no unresolved OSHA violations or history of serious workplace injuries. Additionally, our outdoor inventory storage is securely protected from weather and theft, ensuring the highest level of compliance and safety.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Ace Hardware & Home Improvement operates a seasonal lawn care service in addition to its retail store, focusing on providing customers with professional tools and supplies for outdoor maintenance.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Losses occurred on the following dates: 01/15/2022 due to a slip and fall incident resulting in $15,000; 06/22/2022 due to theft of inventory valued at $10,000; and 11/10/2022 due to water damage from a burst pipe amounting to $5,000. All claims have been reported and are currently in a resolved status.
FIELDS.Combined Single Limit: $1,000,000 Combined Single Limit with a $2,500 deductible
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Saturday: 7:00 AM to 8:00 PM, Sunday: 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security personnel on-site during business hours and after-hours patrols to deter theft and vandalism.
